meta.name: google-ads-audit
meta.description: Google Ads account audit and business context setup. Run this first — it gathers business information, analyzes account health, and saves context that all other ads skills reuse. Trigger on "audit my ads", "ads audit", "set up my ads", "onboard", "account overview", "how's my account", "ads health check", "what should I fix in my ads", or when the user is new to NotFair and hasn't run an audit before. Also trigger proactively when other ads skills detect that business-context.json is missing.

copy.tagline: 审计谷歌广告账户并设置业务上下文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你管理谷歌广告账户并需要快速了解账户健康状况。
copy.tagline_en: Audit your Google Ads account and set up business context
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Google Ads accounts and need a quick health overview.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先检查你的 Google Ads 账户健康度，收集业务信息，并保存一份业务档案。之后它会给出三个核心指标（浪费金额、需求捕获率、每次转化成本），并指出每个指标的最大问题和修复方向。整个过程只读，不会修改你的账户。
howto.when: 当你对 Claude 说“审计我的广告”、“账户概览”、“广告健康检查”等关键词，或者你第一次使用 NotFair 且未运行过审计时触发。其他广告技能发现缺少业务档案时也会主动触发。

say.text: 审计我的 Google Ads 账户
say.note: 触发完整审计，包括业务信息收集和账户健康诊断。

say.text: 只看 campaign X 的浪费情况
say.note: 限定范围审计，只分析指定广告系列。
触发账户健康检查，输出三个核心指标。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude audits your Google Ads account health, gathers business info, and saves a business context file. It outputs three pulse metrics (waste, demand captured, CPA) with top contributors and fix pointers. Read-only, never modifies your account.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "audit my ads", "account overview", "ads health check", or similar phrases, or when you're new to NotFair and haven't run an audit. Also triggered proactively by other ads skills when business-context.json is missing.

say_en.note: Triggers full audit including business context and health diagnosis.

say_en.text: Focus on campaign X for waste
say_en.note: Scoped audit for a specific campaign.

say_en.text: How healthy is my ads account?
say_en.note: Triggers health check with three pulse metrics.
